dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Can you write your full name here, please?
dialogue.reading: kən juː ˈraɪt jʊr ˌfʊl ˈneɪm ˈhɪr, ˈpliːz?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Sure. I don't have a middle name. Is that OK?
dialogue.reading: ˈʃʊr. aɪ ˈdoʊnt ˈhæv ə ˈmɪdəl ˌneɪm. ɪz ðæt oʊˈkeɪ?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Yes, that's OK. Marital status: single or married?
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, ðæts oʊˈkeɪ. ˈmærɪtəl ˌsteɪtəs: ˈsɪŋɡəl ɔːr ˈmærid?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I'm a student at a university in Bangkok.
dialogue.reading: aɪm ə ˈstuːdənt ət ə ˌjuːnɪˈvɜːrsəti ɪn ˈbæŋkɑːk.
